title: Why does paper fold so well?
ai_summary:

title: Formal methods and the future of programming
ai_summary:
• Formal methods are a set of techniques that use mathematical logic to prove software correctness.
• These methods can significantly reduce bugs and improve software reliability with rigorous testing.
• Applications of formal methods are expanding to areas like AI, cybersecurity, and blockchain development.
student_angle: Learn formal methods, as they can enhance career prospects in rigorous software development and testing roles.

title: Chaosnet (1981)
ai_summary:
• Chaosnet was a pioneering local area network (LAN) developed at MIT in 1981.
• It allowed communication between various minicomputers and allowed users to access shared files.
• The network was the first to use a packet-switching architecture.
student_angle: Learn Chaosnet history to understand evolution of computer networking and cloud infrastructure principles.
